judgement_by: Hon.Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner is the employer engaged in the business of collecting coconut and processing the same in its factory and mainly exports its value-added products. The 3rd to 43rd Respondents were its employees who were engaged in the purpose of collecting and transporting coconuts from estates belonging to various suppliers; they had made a complaint that their overtime due were miscalculated and not properly paid. On that, the 2nd Respondent calculated the overtime on the basis of salary paid in terms of the regulations thereunder the Motor Traffic Transport Wages Board Ordinance; Petitioner challenged the same. Held – writ issued since there is miscalculation of overtime payment which is meant to be based on the employer’s trade or business, instead had been treated as a transport business; if it is a transport business, only minimum wages should be considered.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
